full_judgment: Bimalendu Bikash Roy Chowdhury J : This is a petition by the plaintiff for leave to appeal from the judgment and order dated 6 May 1999 of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 3216 of 1997 whereby, in reversal of the lower appellate Court's decree that of the trial Court was restored, dismissing the plaintiffs' suit.
